lead: Mohammad Kaif is an Indian cricketer, born on 1 December 1980 in Prayagraj.
As of 2026, he is 45 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Uttar Pradesh cricket team.
